A **probability space** $(\Omega,\mathcal{F}, \mathbb{P})$ consists of:

1. A **sample space** $\Omega$ - a set of outcomes of a random experiment;
2. A **$\sigma$-algebra** $\mathcal{F}$ - a collection of subsets of $\Omega$
   with specific properties; and
3. A **probability measure** $\mathbb{P}$.
